_doc: Perk tonics. Effects are applied by autoload/perk_manager.gd via effect keys. T-082: every tonic has a one-line 'desc' (the pause menu's perk list, PauseMenu.perk_desc) and its cap glyph is drawn by ui/perk_cap.gd ('abbr' is only the fallback for a tonic without a glyph case). Base measures raised ~10-15% in T-082 (PERKS_LORE.md section 1.0).
_cap_doc: T-081: a survivor holds up to `cap` tonics (PerkManager.base_cap / cap_for); Classic Rules (Settings) keeps the genre's old four (`classic_cap`). Read once per match (the host's value in co-op). Extra slots on top: the Map 1 egg's permanent slot (cap_for). A bot's bonus perk and the tonic tiers take no slot.

ironhide_stout.name: Ironhide Stout
ironhide_stout.desc: Thicker skin: you stand a sixth hit that would have dropped anyone else.

2.name: Riveted Hoops
2.desc: Seven hits instead of six, and your health starts coming back 40% sooner.

3.name: Sunday Best
3.desc: A hit that leaves you under 30% health turns your skin to iron for 2 s: nothing gets through. Once every 40 s.

4.name: Cast Iron
4.desc: Permanent: never lost on a down. And once a round, the hit that would put you down leaves you standing on your last breath instead, with 3 s where nothing gets through.

second_wind.name: Second Wind Schnapps
second_wind.desc: You get the fallen up in a fraction of the time; alone, it stands you back up itself, three times a match.

2.name: Breathe Again
2.desc: Revives go 25% faster again, and whoever you get up (you too, after a self-revive) runs 30% faster for 5 s.

3.name: The Nurse's Count
3.desc: The revived get 3 s where nothing can hurt them, and getting up knocks every zombie within 4 m off its feet.

4.name: The Second Sunrise
4.desc: Permanent. Revives are instant, the revived get 5 s nobody can touch, and in solo a spent self-revive comes back every 10 rounds.

trigger_tonic.name: Trigger Tonic
trigger_tonic.desc: Every reload done in well under half the time, on every gun you carry.

2.name: Shift Quota
2.desc: Swap weapons 40% faster, and reloads shave off a little more.

3.name: Fresh Clip
3.desc: For 2 s after a reload finishes, your shots deal 30% more damage.

4.name: Live Rounds
4.desc: Permanent. Reload a magazine with a third or less left in it and the next 6 rounds are shock rounds: 60% harder, and they knock the target off its feet.

twin_barrel.name: Twin Barrel Bitters
twin_barrel.desc: Every gun fires half as fast again, from the pistol to the machine gun.

2.name: The Major's Moustache
2.desc: A touch faster again, and the gun climbs 30% less as you fire.

3.name: Both Barrels
3.desc: One shot in four doesn't use a round.

marathon_malt.name: Marathon Malt
marathon_malt.desc: Sprint as long as you like, and move a step quicker everywhere.

2.name: Running Home
2.desc: Faster on your feet, and the gun comes up out of a sprint almost at once.

3.name: Vreni's Step
3.desc: Sprinting, you sidestep one swipe every 8 s (no damage) and get a 1.5 s burst of speed.

4.name: Through the Crowd
4.desc: Permanent. Sprint into zombies and they go down: anything you run into is knocked off its feet (not the big ones).

hawkeye_brandy.name: Hawkeye Brandy
hawkeye_brandy.desc: Steadier sights that come up quicker, and a headshot hits a good deal harder.

2.name: The Owl
2.desc: A headshot kill puts a round back in the magazine.

3.name: Sowa's Patience
3.desc: An aimed shot taken 1.2 s or more after your last one hits 75% harder.

4.name: The Long Count
4.desc: Permanent. A headshot kill sends a half-strength shot on to the nearest zombie within 15 m.

packmule_porter.name: Packmule Porter
packmule_porter.desc: Room for a third gun on your back, and one more grenade on your belt.

2.name: Ammer's Ledger
2.desc: Ammo at the chalk and at ammo boxes costs half, and you carry another grenade.

3.name: Training Load
3.desc: At the start of every round each gun you carry gets 20% of its reserve back, and you get a grenade.

4.name: Quartermaster
4.desc: Permanent. Every round each gun you carry gets 30% of its reserve back and a full magazine, and you get a grenade.

blastproof_bock.name: Blastproof Bock
blastproof_bock.desc: Your own explosives and a long fall can't hurt you, and a slide sends a shockwave through the pack.

2.name: Liability Waiver
2.desc: Explosions that reach you heal you 25 instead, and the slide shockwave hits harder.

3.name: Demolition School
3.desc: The slide shockwave grows with the round (at least 60% of a zombie's health), reaches further and knocks survivors down.

4.name: Sapper's Pride
4.desc: Permanent. The slide shockwave hits twice as hard, reaches 5 m and kills crawlers outright.

overclock_cordial.name: Overclock Cordial
overclock_cordial.desc: Reloading an emptier magazine lets off a static burst that shocks everything near you.
overclock_cordial._doc: WEAPONS.md section 20.2: reloading releases a static burst scaling with how empty the mag was (e = 1 - mag/mag_size). Wired by PerkManager.overclock_reload (called from WeaponHolder.start_reload and on an overheat vent). Shape 'coil' shares the cabinet footprint 0.8 x 2.3 x 0.6 (Map 0 placement). 'neon' is the sign/spark colour (violet) over the teal enamel 'color' (and the bolt on its cap). T-082: radius 2.5 + 4.0 e (was 3.5 e), damage 0.66 x health(r) x e (was 0.6), bosses 1700 e (was 1500), 12 targets (was 10).

2.name: Live Wire
2.desc: The burst recharges in 2 s, and arcs jump to 3 more zombies up to twice its reach (half damage).

3.name: Aftershock
3.desc: A burst from a magazine 75% empty or more rings again 0.8 s later at half strength.

4.name: Dynamo
4.desc: Permanent. The burst recharges in 1.5 s, and every burst from a magazine 40% empty or more rings a second time at full strength.

skyhook_sekt.name: Skyhook Sekt
skyhook_sekt.desc: Air control, one hop in the air, soft landings and longer slides. The floor is a suggestion.
skyhook_sekt._doc: UPDATE 07 (T-105, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md section 7.1, JINGLES.md section 14): ELEVATION, DMS-VP-ELV-08. air_accel_mult scales movement.json air_accel; air_hops = extra jumps in the air (air_hop_mult x jump_velocity), reset on landing; safe_landing = no land_speed_loss, no land head dip, landing_shake_mult on the shake; slide_speed_mult / slide_duration_mult on player.json slide; push_resist cuts Player.external_push (turbulence, breaches), pull_resist the Lodestone / Bordwart pulls. Shape 'glider': a tall slim fuselage cabinet, footprint 0.8 x 2.4 x 0.7.

2.name: Thermal
2.desc: The hop also resets on a slide; a slide-jump launches harder; sprint-out after a landing is instant.

3.name: Stall Turn
3.desc: Landing from a hop stomps: zombies within 2.5 m are staggered and hurt (bosses a little).

4.name: Kite String
4.desc: Permanent. Two hops in the air, and the landing stomp reaches 4 m and hits much harder.

magpie_mead.name: Magpie Mead
magpie_mead.desc: Your kills sometimes drop a clip, a few Scrip or a grenade. Pick it up. It's yours now.
magpie_mead._doc: UPDATE 07 (T-105, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md section 7.2, JINGLES.md section 15): RECOVERY, DMS-VP-REC-09, the Allied-pattern cabinet. A kill by the holder rolls magpie_chance (magpie_head_chance on head and melee kills) for a MagpieDrop at the body: ammo (magpie_mags magazines of the holder's current gun; a wonder weapon gets one charge), Scrip (base + per_round x round, capped) or a grenade, by the magpie_w_* weights; the drop lives magpie_life s, the holder only unless magpie_shared. Shape 'bandit': a cabinet with a one-armed-bandit lever, footprint 0.9 x 2.3 x 0.65.

2.name: Scavenger
2.desc: Drops come more often and hold two magazines; your salvage bonus is doubled.

3.name: Pawn Shop
3.desc: Anyone can take your drops; every 25th drop is a power-up; drops near a taught gun's kill hold upgraded ammo.

4.name: Treasury
4.desc: Permanent. Drops come one kill in four, last twice as long, and every 12th is a power-up.

upgrades._doc: Perk upgrades (DECISIONS T-075, docs/gravelight/PERKS_LORE.md section 1). Each perk has tiers 2 and 3 ('tiers' in its row): bought in the match at the machine you already drank from (hold Use), once the power is on and the round is at least min_round; the profile-wide gate is mastery: points earned with the perk in your system (per_kill for every kill, per_round for every round you finish holding it) unlock each tier for good (unlock). A tier's effects merge over the perk's own (same key = the tier's value). Tiers count no extra cap slot, go with the perk when it is lost, and carry with it (campaign exfil, co-op snapshot). marks = the HUD cap's tier mark. U08 (T-129): tier 4 'perma perks': bought at the machine once tier 3 is held and the power is on, from min_round 4 (no later than tier 3's), unlocked with tier 3's mastery; 12000-15000 Scrip by the tonic's strength. A tonic at permanent_tier or above is never lost: not on a down, a bleed-out and respawn, or a self-revive; it still counts toward the cap. Classic Rules keeps every tier off.
